summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K with a press release detailing periodic buyback transactions under its €3.5 billion multi-year share repurchase program announced at the 2025 Capital Markets Day. The third tranche, €250 million announced September 1, 2026, purchased 35,641 common shares between September 2-4, 2026, for approximately €12.68 million across Euronext Milan and NYSE. Total program purchases since January 5, 2026 reached €523.4 million. Treasury holdings as of September 4 were 1,626,445 shares (0.92% of issued shares). The company executes routine open-market buybacks; no premium, tender offer, or special dividend is involved.
